items.title: Nvidia faces deepening scrutiny over China chip ties, CEO affair
items.summary: Allegations linking Huang to a suspected Chinese spy have triggered a board investigation and renewed scrutiny of Nvidia’s chip shipments to China.

items.title: Koshi recognises 13 additional languages for official use
items.summary: The new provision brings the number of languages recognised for government business in the province to 14, including Nepali.

items.title: Palpa’s Dhaka cloth weaves its way from festive gifts to tourist keepsakes
items.summary: Growing demand for Dhaka products as gifts for brothers and relatives during Tihar is helping sustain a traditional craft that embodies Nepal’s cultural identity, even as local production and employment decline.

items.title: Nepal’s push for Himalayan climate agenda falls short at COP31
items.summary: Proposal by Nepal, Bhutan and Kyrgyzstan fails to secure a separate place in formal negotiations; Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal says lack of support from major negotiating blocs remains a hurdle.

items.title: Behind Bangladesh’s garment boom, workers cut food, healthcare as wages fall short
items.summary: Bangladesh’s garment workers say stagnant wages and rising living costs are forcing families to cut back on food, forgo healthcare and pull children out of school, even as the industry drives the country’s export…

items.title: Karnali announces trials for 14 sports ahead of National Games
items.summary: Provincial selections will run from November 13 to 20, while athletes in 31 disciplines will undergo closed-camp training ahead of the December 2-13 competition.

items.title: Nepal celebrates Bhai Tika, the final day of Tihar
items.summary: Sisters apply colourful tika to their brothers, praying for their long life, good health and prosperity in a festival rooted in religious belief and family bonds.

items.title: Woman killed in elephant attack in Kanchanpur
items.summary: A herd of elephants entered a settlement inside Shuklaphanta National Park, damaged a house and trampled a 60-year-old woman to death while she was asleep.

items.title: Pakistan blames India’s Diwali fireworks for Lahore’s toxic air
items.summary: Pakistan says winds carried pollution from Diwali fireworks in India into Lahore, pushing the city’s air quality index to 263 and making it the world’s most polluted major city for a second consecutive day.

items.title: US jury finds Naresh Bhatt guilty of murdering wife Mamta Kafle
items.summary: The Virginia jury also convicted Bhatt of concealing and defiling his wife’s body, which has never been found. He had claimed she died by suicide before he dismembered and disposed of her remains.
